context: A dad and son look at toys
purpose: Teach: カプセル/新潮社/リボン/ハガキ/シンガー/スティング/ムシ/喋っ

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、カプセル玩具のコレクション、増えたな。
lines.en: Your capsule-toy collection's really grown, hasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant. Opens soft, noticing. Gentle upswing at the end—invitation to share rather than interrogation. Relaxed shoulder-space.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!新潮社の図鑑、面白いよ!
lines.en: Yeah! The Shinchosha encyclopedia is so cool!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. Quick bright attack. Vowels open and alive. No self-consciousness, pure excitement. Words tumble slightly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お母さんが、リボンでプレゼント包んでくれた。
lines.en: Your mom wrapped it with a ribbon as a gift.
lines.style: Tender recall. Soft mid-register. Slight pause before 'ribbon' — picturing it. The tone of a father noticing what his partner did for his son. Genuine, not performing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ハガキ、おばあちゃんに送ろう。
lines.en: Let's send a postcard to Grandma!
lines.style: Brisk, purposeful energy. Bright attack on the idea itself. Matter-of-fact and pleased. Six-year-old logic: we have good news, Grandma should hear it. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お父さんは、若い頃、ロックシンガー目指してた。
lines.en: When I was young, I wanted to be a rock singer.
lines.style: Softer tempo, slight remove. Nostalgic but grounded—not romanticizing. A small smile in the voice. Trailing slightly on 'singer' like he's holding the memory a moment longer. Self-deprecating underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Pure, genuine curiosity. Open, direct. No self-doubt—just asking what he doesn't know. Light, unaffected. The question of a child who trusts the adult will answer.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 有名な歌手だ。今度、聞かせよう。
lines.en: He's a famous singer. I'll play some for you sometime.
lines.style: Clear, reassuring. Matter-of-fact statement followed by gentle promise. No rush, no pressure—something to look forward to. Calm, grounded dad-confidence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: クワガタムシ、夏に捕まえるって、お父さん約束した?
lines.en: You promised we'd catch stag beetles in the summer, remember?
lines.style: Quiet urgency underneath the surface. Not accusatory—checking, making sure. Slightly hopeful, slightly worried he might have forgotten. Small voice holding onto something important.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、たくさん喋ったから、疲れたな。
lines.en: Yeah, we sure did talk a lot. I'm beat.
lines.style: Fond exhaustion with contentment underneath. Warm close. Exhale on the last word. The tiredness of a father who's been fully present. Genuine, easy, no edge.
